originality.rationale: The focal novel assertion is the exact modular rank for all prime powers and the complete prime-field Smith diagonal for the selected toric affine line incidence. Classic complex Jacobi-sum magnitudes are treated as prior knowledge. Inspected primary work on full finite-geometry incidence and standard Radon transforms does not state these restricted arithmetic results. Hidden equivalence remains a historical-priority risk.
residual_risks: A prior modular incidence or association-scheme result phrased for restricted blocks could imply the Smith formula without matching the literal torus terminology.
Current comparison is bounded and does not establish global historical novelty.

value.rationale: A natural square line-tomography transform has exact rational inversion while losing an explicitly quantified, rapidly increasing fraction of information in its defining characteristic. Its complete prime-field Smith form gives all integer modulus recovery obstructions. Both are structural infinite-family classifications, not a small finite recomputation.
